meta.description: Monster ability categories and documented form stat lines for the Monster Lab
meta.notes: Documented values are Oulak's form lines, not the save's resolved record. The library shows documented and observed values separately. Two blocks (Ogre** and SuzakuJr.**) match the fixture records' seven stats but carry no BHP line; Mandrake matches the seven stats while the record base HP is 160 and Oulak prints 110. Space Magic counts as Head for the first-ability check but cannot satisfy a requirement.
